notes.title: New update in development: The Robots Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37123055/5d03b20aacb600a33c344c6f44a1fd04b429ef6b.png[/img]

Welcome to another week of discussion for the newest content we are creating for Trashed. The Big
Robots Update!

This new update will have a new set of side quests available from our new robot npc: Mr. Twisk and add
the possibility to buy robots after you earn his trust.

If you want to automate your sites with more than just static machines, this update will be for you. You
will be able to have incinerator, recycler and grinder robots wandering around, doing the work for you!
Mr. Twisk is a good robot... pretty old, but still good. He won’t ask too much from you, only to rescue old
robots and of course, manage more garbage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37123055/92c92f2e096e267355394129f42f30469d6215e8.png[/img]

1 - He needs a lift.
Hey you… Oh.. I thought I was finally able to talk with a robot again but it seems like it’s just a
human.. And a human that I don't even know.. Well, human. If you want to talk with me first I'll
need a small favor. My old friend got lost on this planet a long time ago. He is a trash robot and
can’t work anymore, but I miss his company, can you find him?
Mission : “He needs a lift”
Description: “Mr. Twisk asked you to rescue his friend”
Objective: “Find a trash robot.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37123055/c9eb0f4940569f10846b30589f6c23cb43f11e67.png[/img]

After completing the sidequest you are now able to purchase some robots to start wondering
around your sites:

1 - Incinerator:
A robot that incinerates! It will wander around the sites and burn some trash.
Price: 1500 gold or 50 of each material
Behaviour: Wander dumpsite A or B (you can select the dumpsite in his command
central) looking for garbage to burn.

2 - Recycler:
A robot that does a job similar to a recycler, but mobilized. Moves around making good use of garbage
and processing it into various materials.
Price: 1500 gold or 50 of each material
Behaviour: Wander dumpsite A or B (you can select the dumpsite in his command
central) looking for garbage to recycle.

3 - Grinder:
A robot that grinds the big garbage up for you! He will be able to locate and deal with the
garbage that for some reason didn't make it to the conveyor belts.
Price: 1500 gold or 50 of each material
Behaviour: Wander dumpsite A or B (you can select the dumpsite in his command
central) looking for garbage to grind

notes.title: Trashed Pre-Alpha 0.55 New Horizons Update
notes.content:
New: 

-Added the Tutorial Boxes! A better way of showcase stuff you have enabled in the planet.
-Added the mdc broadcast system for missions! Now you have a way to check the progression of the MDC questline without having
to open the contracts tab.
-Added a new sub-menu in the inventory screen! You may press the "Perks" button to check your unlocked/locked perks.
-Added the New Horizons Update! With 6 brand new missions to gain reputation within the MDC, now you have a real way of progress
in the planet, unlocking a new dumpsite when you fully finish it. Do you think you can handle the MDC assignments?
-Added a better way of checking the missions you have completed in the contracts menu from the pause menu.

Changed:

-Changed the minimap borders.
-Changed the notification position and visual, now it is in the bottom of the screen and doenst have the black background. 
-Changed the old mdc learning system to the tutorial boxes.

New Horizons Update:

Talk with the foreman after completing the initial objectives to start the MDC questline:

1 - Pest Control

Alright kid! It's time to earn your keep. Quit bein' lazy and get to work! We've got ass stabbin' sandcrabs wandering around the facility, it's time to destroy them.

Mission : "Pest Control"
Description: "Foreman asked you to destroy 3 sandcrabs"
Objective: "Destroy 3 sandcrabs 0/3"

2 - Get the feeling

Alright, you've proved that you can get a little dirty. But do you really have the heart to go all the way? It's gonna get intense, kid. You better be on your game. Now i need you to really get the feeling of what a waste manager is, go burn some garbages.

Mission : "Get the feeling"
Description: "Foreman asked you to burn 40 garbages"
Objective: "Burn 40 garbages 0/40"

3 - No more waste

Hey kid, it seems that you are really getting the knack of things. Now it's time to take another step in your career, not just managing waste but recycling too. It's time to learn how to get the most out of the Recycler structure.

Mission : "No more waste"
Description: "Foreman asked you to recycle 40 garbages"
Objective: "Recycle 40 garbages 0/40"

4 - Site cleaning

Hey rookie, I heard you did a pretty good job cleaning Site A.. But that was the easy part!
We have more than just one dumpsite on this planet! While you handled
Site A, some outlaws built a fort on Site B. MDC is asking for you to
clean it up so we can start using it. Do you think you can handle that? Grab your guns because it's
time for you to learn that a waste manager needs to be good with weapons too.

Mission: “Site Cleaning”
Description: “Corporation is asking for you to clean a outlaws fort on dumpsite B”
Objective: “Destroy 3 outlaw shooters 0/3”

5 - It’s time to move on

As much as I hate to say it, MDC asked me to send you a thank you. Your hard work is getting recognized out there.
Soon we can start using Site B to handle garbage. But there is a big problem. Even after eliminating the outlaws, the site is still not quite ready yet.
Fortunately we have a system in place that can blast through the rock piles to allow you
to build structures there. Do this by attaching the explosives to the rock outcroppings. You will need X plastic and
X metal to craft each explosive, so make sure to have some spare resources. Good luck.

Mission: “It’s time to move on”
Description: “Use explosives to clean Site B”
Objective: “Destroy 5 rock piles 0/4”

6 - Final preparations

We are getting pretty close to finally being able to leave this rotten planet, thanks to you
rookie. I just need a few more things from you before we're done.
Remember how well you managed Site A? Now I need you to do the same with Site
B. Go in there and build as many structures as you can.

Mission: “Final preparations”
Description: “Automatize everything for dumpsite B EVERYTHING!”
Objectives:
“Build 3 incinerators”
“Build 3 recyclers”
“Build 3 grinders”
“Build 10 conveyors belts”
“Build 1 Battery”
“Build 1 solar panel”

notes.title: TRASHED 0.50 THE PROFESSIONS UPDATE!
notes.content:
New: 

-Data for the garbages! now the game can save the garbages you had previously, no more vanishing garbages every time you close the game.
-More UI adjustments.
-Fully implemented the professions system, start a new game and be prepared to choose the profession that fits perfectly with your playstile.

Engineer:
    With this profession, your goal is to build as much stuff as you can. You will be able to use less materials and unlock perks for your structures.
    Receive xp by purchasing diagrams, and of course, placing structures.

    Level 1 : Every structure you build starts with 50% more health and a 10% speed boost. 
    Level 2 : You will use 25% less materials for each build. 
    Level 3 : Free material supplier delivery (random material and random quantity) everyday in the morning. 
    Level 4 : With your knowledge you were able to build a electric field device that you carry with you. Structures within 5 meters will receive energy. 
    Level 5 : You permanently receive the ability to perk your structures. Every structure has a unique perk now.
    
    The perks are: 
	Air Purifier - Reduce the work speed from 10 to 8 seconds and heal the player by 1hp if within a radius of 3 meters. DONE
	Battery - Increase the max capacity of energy stored from 200 to 800. DONE
	Conveyor Belt - Increase the work speed by 50%. DONE
	Garbage Launcher - Increases the range and attack ratio by 50%. DONE
	Grinder - Removes the grinding delay and increases the number of grinded garbages by 25%. DONE
	Incinerator - Removes the air quality increase from burned garbages and gives a 25% chance of retrieving material from the garbage. DONE
	Recycler - Removes the recycler delay and increases the number of materials by 50%. DONE
	Turret - 25% chance that it will shoot a missile.

Mercenary:
    With this profession you will be rewarded from destroying vicious creatures on the planet. You will get more money and boosted drops for doing the dirty work.
    Receive xp by purchasing weapons and killing creatures.

    Level 1 : You have your health base increased by 25% and all of your weapons do 50% more damage. 
    Level 2 : 50% discount on weapons prices. 
    Level 3 : Every creature you kill will drop some money for you (5$-15$). 
    Level 4 : With your experience you were able to merge some weapons and build 'THE MERCENARY WEAPON'. Permanently unlock this weapon.
    Level 5 : You permanently receive boosted drops from the creatures, meaning you will receive extra stuff for slaying them. 

Adventurer:
    With this profession you will be rewarded to explore the map and complete missions. You will receive a boost on your move speed and a jetpack.
    Receive xp by completing objectives, missions and buying items.

    Level 1 : Base movement speed increased by 25%. 
    Level 2 : 15% discount in the price of anything. 
    Level 3 : Every mission you complete will award you with a bonus $200. 
    Level 4 : Everyone from this planet loves you. The foreman has permanently unlocked the 'Lamp' and 'Bridge' diagram. 
    Level 5 : You permanently receive a jetpack, press the spacebar to use it.

Waste Manager:
    With this profession you will be rewarded to manage the garbage that falls on this planet. You will receive money and material bonuses
    for all the trash that you burn. You will be able to unlock the ability of collecting shiny stuff from some garbage.
    Receive xp by burning, recycling, and grinding garbages. 

    Level 1 : You get a 10% move speed bonus while carrying garbage. 
    Level 2 : 25% bonus in the amount of garbages you get by recycling and 50% bonus in the amount of $ you earn by burning them. 
    Level 3 : Permanently increase the work speed of recyclers, grinders and incinerator by 25%.
    Level 4 : If you want to burn more, you need better tools. Permanently increase the blower power by 50% and ammo by 100%. 
    Level 5 : You unlock the ability to collect shiny stuff from garbages. 2.5% of chance to spawning one of them within each dump.

Environmentalist:
    With this profession you will be rewarded by taking care of the planet. Your planet will get a resistance bonus to pollution and
    you will be able to unlock the ability to grow plants.
    Receive xp by placing air purifiers and increasing your planet's air quality. 

    Level 1 : Your planet gets a 25% resistance bonus for pollution. 
    Level 2 : 50% bonus of reduced damage for the air pollution of your health. 
    Level 3 : Permanently increases the air purifiers work speed by 50%. 
    Level 4 : You really did great on this job. Permanently unlock the air mask and reduce the amount of pollution for each garbage by 50%. 
    Level 5 : You unlocked the ability to grow plants on the planet. If your air quality is 250 or higher, plants will start growing in some spots.

FIXES:

-Fixed a bug where the grass would grow even if the air quality was less than 0.
-Decreased the spawn of the ragdolls within each dump.

We want to thank each one of you who joined us in the discussion about this update, we plan to do more of these for each new content we plant to bring for you guys.
We plan to do some adjustments for the professions as well, feel free to give us your feedback about the system in the forums.

notes.title: New content in development: The professions update
notes.content:
Welcome to the first discussion event for Trashed! this week we want to tell you about the newest content we are preparing, a whole new system with [b]professions[/b] that will fit into every playstyle possible. 

If you like to build, now you will be able to have boosted structures with different abilitys and a [b]static field[/b] around you that will power all of your structures within radius!

If you are more into killing stuff, we have a [b]special weapon[/b] for you! and huge boosts for all of your weapons.

If you would like to just walk into this lovely planet, you will be able to unlock a [b]jetpack[/b] now!

With this system, you have to choose a initial profession after the tutorial. You will be able to gain experience by doing stuff related to your choice.

Every profession has a level cap of [b]5[/b] and each level will award you with a specific bonus/perk. But no more talking, lets jump into them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37123055/9107bbdaeb1c502ad6fe6c2b01776a2814eb7698.png[/img]

[b]The Adventurer[/b]

With this profession you will be rewarded to explore the map and complete missions. You will receive a boost on your move speed and a jetpack.
Receive xp by completing objectives, missions and buying items.

[b]Level 1[/b] : Base movement speed increased by 25%.
[b]Level 2[/b] : 15% discount in the price of anything.
[b]Level 3[/b] : Every mission you complete will award you with a bonus $200.
[b]Level 4[/b] : Everyone from this planet loves you. The foreman has permanently unlocked the 'Lamp' and 'Bridge' diagram.
[b]Level 5[/b] : You permanently receive a jetpack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37123055/962254d521f6c3ad23babbe7c0af72109dfe6cf9.png[/img]

[b]The Engineer[/b]

With this profession, your goal is to build as much stuff as you can. You will be able to use less materials and unlock perks for your structures.
Receive xp by purchasing diagrams, and of course, placing structures.

[b]Level 1[/b] : Every structure you build starts with 50% more health and a 10% speed boost. 
[b]Level 2[/b] : You will use 25% less materials for each build. 
[b]Level 3[/b] : Free material supplier delivery (random material and random quantity) everyday in the morning. 
[b]Level 4[/b] : With your knowledge you were able to build a electric field device that you carry with you. Structures within 5 meters will receive energy.
[b]Level 5[/b] : You permanently receive the ability to perk your structures. Every structure you build will have a different perk enabled.

[b]The structure perks are:[/b]

[b]Air Purifier[/b] - Reduce the work speed from 10 to 8 seconds and heal the player by 1hp if within a radius of 3 meters. 
[b]Battery[/b] - Increase the max capacity of energy stored from 200 to 800.
[b]Conveyor Belt[/b] - Increase the work speed by 50%. 
[b]Garbage Launcher[/b] - Increases the range and attack ratio by 50%.
[b]Grinder[/b] - Removes the grinding delay and increases the number of grinded garbages by 25%. 
[b]Incinerator[/b] - Removes the air quality increase from burned garbages and gives a 25% chance of retrieving material from the garbage.
[b]Recycler[/b] - Removes the recycler delay and increases the number of materials by 50%.
[b]Turret[/b]- 25% chance that it will shoot a missile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37123055/d5813b2db4dce720762e64c7a732dbcf6eb13b18.png[/img]

[b]The Environmentalist[/b]

With this profession you will be rewarded by taking care of the planet. Your planet will get a resistance bonus to pollution and you will be able to unlock the ability to grow plants.
Receive xp by placing air purifiers and increasing your planet's air quality.

[b]Level 1[/b] : Your planet gets a 25% resistance bonus for pollution.
[b]Level 2[/b] : 50% bonus of reduced damage for the air pollution of your health.
[b]Level 3[/b]: Permanently increases the air purifiers work speed by 50%.
[b]Level 4[/b] : You really did great on this job. Permanently unlock the air mask and reduce the amount of pollution for each garbage by 50%.
[b]Level 5[/b] : You unlocked the ability to grow plants on the planet. If your air quality is 250 or higher, plants will start growing in some spots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37123055/12499d715a2abf544abf93fe0eb50933e9b0169e.png[/img]

[b]The Mercenary[/b]

With this profession you will be rewarded from destroying vicious creatures on the planet. You will get more money and boosted drops for doing the dirty work.
Receive xp by purchasing weapons and killing creatures.

[b]Level 1[/b] : You have your health base increased by 25% and all of your weapons do 50% more damage.
[b]Level 2[/b] : 50% discount on weapons prices.
[b]Level 3[/b] : Every creature you kill will drop some money for you (5$-15$).
[b]Level 4[/b] : With your experience you were able to merge some weapons and build 'THE MERCENARY WEAPON'. Permanently unlock this weapon.
[b]Level 5[/b] : You permanently receive boosted drops from the creatures, meaning you will receive extra stuff for slaying them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37123055/5b08fc6d479899fe4ce8103b71f62f63b6442b18.png[/img]

[b]Waste Manager[/b]

With this profession you will be rewarded to manage the garbage that falls on this planet. You will receive money and material bonuses for all the trash that you burn. You will be able to unlock the ability of collecting shiny stuff from some garbage.
Receive xp by burning, recycling, and grinding garbages.

[b]Level 1[/b] : You get a 10% move speed bonus while carrying garbage.
[b]Level 2[/b] : 25% bonus in the amount of garbages you get by recycling and 50% bonus in the amount of $ you earn by burning them.
[b]Level 3[/b] : Permanently increase the work speed of recyclers, grinders and incinerator by 25%.
[b]Level 4[/b] : If you want to burn more, you need better tools. Permanently increase the blower power by 50% and ammo by 100%.
[b]Level 5[/b] : You unlock the ability to collect shiny stuff from garbages. 2.5% of chance to spawning one of them when burning garbage.

And that is all for this week! We plan to do a lot of these discussions events in the future to be in sync with everyone of you about the new contents we are planning. We want to thank every one of the players we have now, its been a pleasure to deliver updates to you guys, and we hope to do a lot more!

If you have any feedback, feel free to leave it here or in the community forums. And dont forget to leave us a review if you like the game :D

notes.title: The Big FPS Update
notes.content:
The BIG FPS Update is here!

Thank you for your continued support as always.

Warning: Be sure to start a new save game, as so many things are completely new that it will break the old one.

Trashed is now a full fledged FPS. Watch huge garbage dumps from first person, fully immersive.
All new drone view, press U to cruise around the dump site from a drone's point of view,
and shoot at sand crabs while you're up there.

What's new:

New FPS mode
New Drone mode (U)
New Shops and items to find and buy
New Inventory (I)
New Boots, Vests, Masks, Helmets and other items
New Risers and ramps to create tall structures
New Maggots! What would trash be without maggots?
New Explosive Barrels
Improved Enemy models and AI
Improved overall user interface
Improved Build Menu
Improved Pause Menu
Updated contracts
Updated saving system
Improved models for guns/fps view
Improved effects
Post effects and Shadows On/Off Option
More missions
Various structure fixes
Tons of bug fixes

What's next?

We have a big update planned after this one. :)
